    About AutoCraft: Car Restoration Specialists

    AutoCraft is a restoration and repair workshop for classic and modern cars. We combine certified technicians, modern diagnostic equipment and genuine parts to bring each vehicle back to its best.

    Our story

    We started AutoCraft because too many owners were told a car was not worth saving. A careful inspection and the right skills often prove otherwise.

    Today our team handles everything from brake and tire work to full body, interior and drivetrain restorations. Whether the car is a weekend classic or a modern hybrid, the standard is the same: do the job properly and explain it clearly.

    What we stand for

    • Precision

      Measured, documented work, from the first inspection to the final road test.

    • Honesty

      You receive a clear written estimate and we ask before any extra work begins.

    • Quality parts

      Genuine or equivalent-quality parts, chosen for fit, safety and long life.

    How a project works

    1. Inspect

      We assess the car, run diagnostics and record what we find.

    2. Quote

      You get a written plan with scope and cost before work starts.

    3. Restore

      Our technicians carry out the work and keep you updated.

    4. Test and deliver

      We road test the car, review the work with you and hand back the keys.
